description: Turn a HAR capture of a claude.ai artifact into a local folder that runs standalone (frame runtime stripped, sibling files included).

strip-headers.description: Rewrite the HAR in place without any request or response headers or cookies (the capturing browser's session). Run first.

list.description: List the artifact frame files a HAR captured (URL without query, status, type, size; never headers). Pass --all for every entry.

args.name: --all
args.description: List every entry, not just artifact frames

extract.description: Write index.html (as served), run.html (frame runtime stripped) and every sibling file into a new folder; warns about referenced files the HAR missed.

args.name: out
args.description: Absolute path of a new or empty folder

args.name: --version
args.description: Frame version to extract when the HAR holds several (see list)
